# eclipse-coverage

[All servers](../mcp-tools.md)

Version: 1.0.0. Tools: 3.

Eclipse code coverage tools using EclEmma for test coverage analysis

## getClassCoverage

Get detailed coverage information for a specific class, including line-by-line coverage and branch coverage. Returns annotated source with covered/uncovered lines.

Input schema type: object.

| Parameter | Schema type | Java type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| className | string | String | Yes | Class name: fully qualified (e.g., 'com.example.Calculator'), simple name (e.g., 'Calculator'), or filename (e.g., 'Calculator.java') |

## getCoverageReport

Get overall coverage report for the last coverage session. Shows which code has been executed during tests.

Input schema type: object.

No parameters.

## runCoverage

Launch a test configuration with EclEmma code coverage analysis enabled. Async by default with file logging. Requires EclEmma plugin to be installed.

Input schema type: object.

| Parameter | Schema type | Java type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| configName | string | String | Yes | Name of the launch configuration to run with coverage |
| waitForCompletion | boolean | Boolean | No | If true, waits for the process to terminate (max 120s). Default: false |
